proposedDecisionTable.status: Declarative policy and future test contract; no evaluator implemented
proposedDecisionTable.evaluation: Validate inputs first. Evaluate rules in listed order; first match selects exactly one disposition. Collect all blockers independently before choosing primary status. Missing fields are schema errors, never default PASS. eq/neq are strict equality/inequality, in is enum membership; all/any have Boolean semantics.

fieldSemantics.sourceIntegrity: Actual raw row revision, bilingual field boundaries, locator and label/code coherence.
fieldSemantics.licenseUse: Right to use all dependency artifacts in selected profile. Export clearance is independent.
fieldSemantics.identity: Source SCTID and candidate FMA identities resolve. For zero candidates only source identity resolution applies.
fieldSemantics.version: Pinned source interpretation or approved historical-version bridge, selected ontology snapshots and atlas identity binding.
fieldSemantics.ambiguity: Conflicting approved assertions or competing credible targets; never choose by majority or score.
fieldSemantics.laterality: PASS means documented exact compatibility for exact/undetermined candidates; for supported nonexact relation it means documented complete laterality assessment consistent with that relation.
fieldSemantics.scope: All entity-kind, boundary, partition, countability, granularity, canonical-context checks completed and consistent with the proposed relation. UNKNOWN on any required fact => UNKNOWN.
fieldSemantics.sep: SEP class/membership sufficiently evidenced and consistent with proposed relation; documented NOT_APPLICABLE passes. Keyword-only never passes.
fieldSemantics.attestationEndpoint: Actual source row SCTID equals the assessed bridge endpoint; no S-to-E evidence substitution.
fieldSemantics.provenance: Acyclic, resolvable proof refs; admitted source/bridge dependencies and human approval attribution valid.
fieldSemantics.relation: Proposed relation entering veto checks, not final canonical relationType. EXACT requires a direct source/approved bridge assertion; unapproved T3-T6 candidates remain UNDETERMINED even when structural checks pass. A vetoed exact proposal must not emit a final exact relation as established fact. NONEXACT_SUPPORTED requires positive typed proof; INCOMPATIBLE requires complete positive rejection evidence.
fieldSemantics.counterpartExhaustion: APPROVED only with signed/reviewed search certificate against entire fixed atlas; no absence inferred from missing candidate generation.
fieldSemantics.exportClearance: Does not affect local semantic decision; independently blocks public serialization unless PUBLIC_CLEARED.

steps: Evaluate all pairs and retain every candidate, rejected relation and blocker.

Treat valid T0/T1/T2 exact targets as authoritative contenders. Treat T3/T4 candidates as credible unresolved contenders only when endpoint/scope evidence supports a different possible exact target. T5/T6 lexical resemblance alone does not veto an otherwise fully proved exact target.
Deduplicate contenders by FMA identity, not label. More than one distinct authoritative/credible target => G03 IDENTITY_REVIEW. Conflicting T1/T2 assertions about the same pair also => G03.
If one exact contender survives without credible alternative, select it and replay G01-G14. Rejected broader/part candidates do not displace it.

If no exact contender survives, prefer unresolved credible identity candidates to completed nonexact candidates; select primary review by G01-G09 precedence across the viable candidates. T3-T6 remaining unresolved candidates => G14.
If no viable exact/undetermined candidates exist and one or more nonexact relations are proved, row => CORROBORATIVE_ONLY; do not select an acceptedFmaId.
If all existing candidates are positively rejected, row => NO_SAFE_MAPPING; if no candidates exist use G04/G05.
Emit exactly one rowDecision. selectedPairId and acceptedFmaId are set only for eligible dispositions; provenance links retain all pairs for all other dispositions.
rowReducer.noCandidateOverride: For a zero-candidate row, supply identity/version/provenance PASS only when source-level identity and pinned search universe are valid; candidate-specific scope fields are ignored by G04/G05.
rowReducer.nonexactAssessment: A known scope difference consistent with a positively proved nonexact relation is assessment PASS, not exact-scope equality. Raw scopeChecks still record mismatch facts; no eligible gate can accept relation NONEXACT_SUPPORTED.
rowReducer.blockerOrdering: Sort reason codes lexicographically; primary queue uses ordered rules, never input order.
rowReducer.blockerRetention: allBlockers retains candidate reason codes, including rejected candidates. unresolvedBlockers contains only unresolved vetoes on row selection; it must be empty for eligible rows. Rejected candidate blockers cannot erase a fully proved selected exact target.

publicExportGate.condition: exportClearance == PUBLIC_CLEARED for record and every transitive dependency

multiAuthority.comparisonKey: same FMA and compatible scope, then Vietnamese NFC + trim + layout-whitespace collapse; preserve case, accents, punctuation and word order
multiAuthority.authorityIdentity: bibliographic work/edition with upstream dependency lineage; copies do not create votes
